project_type: Vite 8 SPA with Three.js globe, GSAP scroll-driven animations, species data pages
build_system: Vite 8 - no special quirks, standard vite build
test_framework: None - no test suite exists. Validation is build success and manual verification.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx vite build and confirm success. 2. Check JSON files are valid with node -e for each. 3. Verify TMDB fetch script runs successfully.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/data/*.json are generated by scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js but also manually editable. dist/ is build output (gitignored).
environment_constraints: Network available - can reach TMDB API, Wikimedia Commons URLs can be referenced. No test framework. No Docker.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Key constraints from user: do NOT add new npm packages, focus on content depth and rendering correctness, every URL must be real and verifiable.
key_patterns: Species data JSON files in public/data/{slug}.json. Species pages in species/{slug}.html load src/species-page.js which fetches JSON and renders DOM. Globe in src/globe.js uses HOTSPOTS array. Main page in index.html with src/main.js orchestrating Three.js + GSAP + Lenis + Barba.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (home), species/*.html (species pages), src/*.js|css (app code), public/data/*.json (species data), scripts/ (build scripts)
